awards_draft.rederivation_notes: My chain before reading the record: (1) eligibility gate (65-game/20-minute rule, award-specific filters such as rookie status, bench-start share, clutch minutes); (2) voter-visible production vs the field; (3) team success/narrative, voter fatigue; (4) ballot aggregation (10-7-5-3-1 for MVP-type, 5-3-1 for All-NBA, positionless), ties paying $1/N; (5) distinct non-media-ballot mechanisms: All-Star starters (50% fan, 25% player, 25% media; reserves by coaches), stat-leader accumulation (KXNBASTATLEADER), Cup MVP (tied to Cup knockout results), Hall of Fame committee, Summer League MVP, team-record markets (KXNBAPOSTASREC), All-Star/celebrity game winners; (6) draft: lottery, pick ownership, board consensus/dispersion, draft-night trades. The record matches 1-4 and 6 closely (the $1/N quotes for KXNBACLUTCH/KXNBACUPMVP and the 'selected as the 1st overall pick' text are verbatim). It differs on (5): it models only a media-ballot election and a draft chain, so a large share of the 55 mapped series have no mechanism or input at all. Rules text exists for only 3 of 55 series, which the record discloses.

findings.text: Missing mechanism: All-Star selection. KXNBAASSTARTERS, KXNBAALLSTARS, KXNBAALLSTAR are driven by a 50% fan / 25% player / 25% media starter formula and coach-picked reserves, with fan-vote dynamics (market size, social following, early-ballot returns). The record's s4 models only ~100 media ballots, and a text search of the record finds zero mentions of 'fan', 'player vote' or 'reserves'. The required inputs (fan-vote returns, weighted-formula arithmetic, frontcourt/backcourt starter slots) are absent. The nba.all_star_process input is audited as KEEP_CONTEXT in off_court_events but never defined here.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added stage s6 and defined nba.allstar_fan_vote_composite (50/25/25 weighted-rank arithmetic with fan-return random walk and 2 guard/3 frontcourt slots), nba.allstar_reserve_coach_vote and an attached nba.all_star_process, with a new fan-vote dataset and u5 flagging the formula and archive as unverified.

findings.text: Archetype/series mis-mapping inside the key: the 55 series span at least six distinct generating processes, and only the ballot election and the draft are modelled. Examples with no mechanism or input: KXNBASTATLEADER (stat accumulation with a qualifying-games rule, not a vote), KXNBACUPMVP (depends on Cup knockout results and the final), KXNBAALLSTARGAME and KXNBACELEBRITYGAME (exhibition game winners), KXNBAPOSTASREC (team record after the break), KXNBAHALLOFFAME (committee election), KXNBASUMMERMVP. The record notes TITLE_ONLY status but gives no per-series routing or gap entry for these, so a consumer will price them with ballot-election inputs.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added 8 series_mapping_issues routing stat leader, Cup MVP, exhibition games, post-break record, Hall of Fame, Summer League MVP and lottery odds to their intended archetypes (or NEW_ARCHETYPE_NEEDED), stated in settlement_definition which processes this record does not cover, and added u6 for the series with no mechanism anywhere.

findings.text: Settlement coverage: the contract text asserts 'matters for monthly awards given per conference and for Hall of Fame classes with several inductees' and that eligibility 'is resolved by the league, not by Kalshi'. Neither is in the three sampled rules; the only sampled tie rule is the $1/N text on KXNBACLUTCH and KXNBACUPMVP. These are inferences presented in the variants list as facts. Also KXNBADRAFTPICK 'a pick traded before the draft still settles on the player chosen' is an inference, since the sampled text is silent on trades and on withdrawal; it belongs in unresolved as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Reworded the two rules_evidence establishes texts and the first two variants so tie-per-conference, Hall of Fame classes, league eligibility and traded-pick settlement are marked as inferences, and added u7 CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS for trades, withdrawal and eligibility binding.

findings.text: Eligibility details are stated as fact in s1 ('65 games with at least 20 minutes ... role rules such as bench-starts for Sixth Man ... qualifying-games rule for stat leaders') but the 15-19 minute allowance and which awards the rule actually governs (Clutch, All-Rookie, monthly awards, Coach/Executive are not covered) are only partly flagged in u3. Defined inputs nba.games_played_eligibility and nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger would be applied to awards the rule does not govern.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added the applicability caveat to stage s1, to the nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger measurement (flag per award, not applied to monthly, Coach/Executive, All-Star or draft markets) and to u3.

findings.text: Inputs left in: nba.voting_narrative is WEAK yet remains the only input for stage s3/s4 narrative effects and for voter fatigue (no proxy defined); nba.minutes is IRRELEVANT but the Player game logs data row still lists minutes. Interaction 'allnba_points_ladder x award_stats' as joint-distribution is a modelling choice (ballot-split simulation), not a measured interaction.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added nba.voter_signal_proxy (public ladders, repeat-winner count, prior share) as the measurable replacement for WEAK nba.voting_narrative in stages s3/s4 and coverage, removed voting_narrative from the feeds, and labelled the ballot-split interaction a modelling choice to validate; nba.minutes appears in the game-log fields only as the minutes column needed for the eligibility ledger, not as an input.

combo_props.rederivation_notes: My chain before reading the record: availability -> minutes scenario mixture (blowout truncation, foul trouble, OT) -> possessions/pace -> per-minute shot, rebound and potential-assist opportunity shares -> conversion (3P luck, teammate finishing, scorer credit) -> positively correlated through minutes/pace but negatively through role split -> sum crosses an integer line (25+ at floor_strike 24.5). Settlement hazards from the rule text: the protected clause voids at the pre-tip fair price when the player 'enters the game during the first half but does not enter the game after the conclusion of the first half' unless he already hit the line; OT inclusion is not stated. Required inputs: injury vintages, minutes mixture, usage/rebound-chance/potential-assist rates, pace, own-model spread, covariance of components, rest/load-management, referee crew. The record agrees on nearly all of this and correctly flags OT as unstated. It differs by leaving rest/load management and referee crew as GAPs rather than attaching them, and by an unexamined reading of the protected clause for starters.

findings.text: Declared GAPs leave the input list incomplete for first-order drivers: situational_schedule_motivation (back-to-back, return-from-injury minute restrictions, load management) and officiating_rules (nba.referee_crew) are GAP although both inputs exist in the catalog (nba.rest_travel, nba.load_mgmt, nba.referee_crew are used in sibling records). A minutes mixture without a restriction/rest regime cannot reproduce the 'restriction: coach-announced' branch the record itself lists in nba.minutes_scenario_mixture. Disclosed in u3/u5/u6, but anyone relying on this list will miss minutes-restriction inputs.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Attached nba.load_mgmt, nba.rest_travel and nba.referee_crew as defined new_inputs (stages s2/s3, data feeds incl. a new referee dataset) and changed situational_schedule_motivation and officiating_rules from GAP to COVERED, leaving the 2026-27 policy and assignment-feed uncertainty in u5/u6.

findings.text: Stage input ids nba.scorer_bias and nba.teammate_conv (s4) are referenced but neither audited in input_audit nor defined in new_inputs; they are not in the archetype's existing inputs. The effective required-input list therefore differs from the audited list. The same pattern recurs in first_basket (nba.starter_probability, nba.status_resolution_prob in coverage) and game_total (nba.series_model).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Attached nba.scorer_bias and nba.teammate_conv (referenced in stage s4) as defined new_inputs with data feeds so the effective input list matches the staged list; reviewer is right that they were not attached, though input_audit can only hold pre-existing archetype inputs.

findings.text: Protected-clause semantics: the rule voids a player who 'enters the game during the first half' but does not 'enter the game after the conclusion of the first half'. A starter does not literally 'enter' at the tip or at the start of the third quarter; whether starters are covered, and what happens to a first-half starter who sits the whole second half in a blowout (not an injury), is not stated. nba.early_exit_hazard is defined only for injury/ejection/illness exits (P(exit before half)), so the blowout-rest branch of the void state is unmodelled and not listed in unresolved.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Extended nba.early_exit_hazard to include the coach-rested second half (blowout) void route with its own estimator, added both void-route variants and u7 CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS on what counts as entering the game in the first half.

findings.text: The void payout is 'the fair price prior to the opening tip', a market-derived reference that exists only after the market is priced. The record says the early exit 'is not a loss for a Yes holder' but never notes that the realised value of the void branch depends on the contract's own pre-tip price (circular for expected-value work); nba.market_calibration_bias etc. are correctly BENCHMARK_ONLY, but this recursion is not flagged.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added a variants note that the protected void pays a market-derived pre-tip fair price, so expected-value work must treat P(void) and the void payout separately and exogenously.

findings.text: Single sampled series (KXNBAPRAPROT); the archetype label includes PR/PA/RA but the contract section generalises ('Unprotected contracts void on inactive or never-on-court' in s1) from the assists rule text, not from any PRA text. rules_secondary in the evidence pack is truncated, so the PRA inactive-player clause was never seen.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Rewrote stage s1 to attribute the unprotected void wording to the KXNBAAST rule rather than any PRA text, and added u7 for the unsampled unprotected PRA/PR/PA wording; rules_verification stays PARTIALLY_VERIFIED.

first_basket.rederivation_notes: My chain: the contract type implied by the key is first made basket scorer / first team to score: starting five confirmed ~30 min pre-tip -> tip winner -> opening-possession race -> scripted first-shot allocation -> shot-type conversion; settlement hazards: what counts as a basket (FT, tip-in), DNP/non-start voids. But the evidence pack shows the only live series under this key are KXNBAOT and KXNBASERIESOT, both overtime markets (Yes if at least 1 OT is played; 48-hour postponement clause). For those the correct chain is regulation-tie probability from the margin density at zero plus late-game tie-forcing and, for the series version, series length x per-game OT. The record correctly recognises the mismatch and derives a first-basket model anyway. My comparison: the first-basket chain is sound as a hypothetical, but none of its inputs (starting five, tip, first-shot share) apply to the live series, so the live series have no usable inputs under this key. I also recomputed the race formula: with pA=pB=0.5, pA/(1-(1-pA)(1-pB)) = 0.667, not the stated 0.56.

findings.text: Series/archetype mis-mapping: both live series (KXNBAOT 'Game goes to overtime', KXNBASERIESOT) are overtime contracts; every stage and input here (starters_pit, tip_first_shot, first_possession_chain_prob, early_game_usage_first6, first_shot_type_make_prob) is irrelevant to them. The record admits 'misfiled' but the required inputs for the actual live contracts (regulation margin density at zero, tie-forcing policy, series length) appear only in game_overtime_and_team_events, which has zero live series. As the catalog stands, KXNBAOT would be evaluated with first-basket inputs. The ledger must be re-keyed or this record must cover the OT series.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Recorded KXNBAOT and KXNBASERIESOT in contract.series_mapping_issues as belonging to game_overtime_and_team_events, prefixed the mechanism summary with a scope note, and removed the claim of covering them; the overtime inputs live in the game_overtime_and_team_events record (conditional on a ledger re-key I cannot perform).

findings.text: The whole mechanism rests on a hypothetical contract: no first-basket or first-team-to-score series was found in the evidence pack, no rules text exists, and rules_verification is only PARTIALLY_VERIFIED because the single quote (KXNBAOT) verifies nothing about first-basket settlement. Inputs rated primary (nba.first_possession_chain_prob, nba.early_game_usage_first6) therefore have no contract that requires them; the archetype's existence on Kalshi is unverified and should be raised as DATA_UNAVAILABLE/OTHER, not just CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u5

findings.text: Numeric error in the central formula: s3 states 'P(A scores first | A has the ball) = pA / (1 - (1-pA)(1-pB)), which is about 0.56 for typical values near 0.5'. At pA=pB=0.5 that formula equals 0.5/0.75 = 0.667; at pA=0.45 it is 0.645. The 0.56 figure, the 'saturating' nonlinearity text ('only large gaps move team-first beyond 0.56') and the claim of a 3-5 point tip effect are inconsistent with the formula in nba.first_possession_chain_prob's own measurement. The stage also treats a 'first trip made FG' as the unit though a trip can end in free throws, which the unresolved FT-counts question affects.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected the central formula values in stage s3 (0.667 at pA=pB=0.5, 0.64 at 0.45/0.5, not 0.56), the tip-effect claim in s2 and the saturating nonlinearity text, and widened pA in nba.first_possession_chain_prob to the contract definition (made FG vs any scoring incl. free throws).

findings.text: Sports-inappropriate settlement language: 'own goals' (u1, variants) is not an NBA concept; a basket credited to the opponent after an own-basket is the relevant edge case and goaltending/tip-in handling should be stated instead. u1 also never lists 'no player scores before game cancellation'.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced the soccer term own goals in the summary-level contract text, variants, category note and u1 with own-basket credit, goaltending and basket interference, and added the cancelled-before-any-score void case to variants and u1.

findings.text: nba.pace and nba.def_scheme are carried as inputs in s3/s5 after being audited WEAK/KEEP_CONTEXT; DATA row 'Team opening-possession and shot-type tables' is fed by Cleaning the Glass and Synergy (paid) with the access label correct, but nba.starter_probability and nba.status_resolution_prob are referenced in stages/coverage without audit or definition.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed WEAK nba.pace from stage s3 and the data feed (pace_volume now NOT_APPLICABLE with reason), and attached nba.starter_probability and nba.status_resolution_prob as audited secondary new_inputs with data feeds; nba.def_scheme stays as KEEP_CONTEXT.

game_moneyline_spread.rederivation_notes: My chain: margin D = home - away over ~200 possessions; mean from active-set ratings (who plays, minute redistribution, non-additive multi-absence) + home court (~2 pts) + rest/travel; sd ~12-13, heteroscedastic in pace; luck regression (3P%, close-game record); coaching/scheme at the margin; availability news timing; series dependence for playoff markets. P(win)=P(D>0); spread is the same density at a cut point. Settlement hazards: OT inclusion, 48-hour postponement -> fair price, strike construction. In the rules text for KXNBAWINMARGIN I see 'wins the game by 6 to 10 points' and the secondary clause 'resolve based on the official final result'; nothing about overtime. The record's mechanism matches mine closely and adds useful non-additive absence and replacement-absorption inputs. It differs by asserting OT inclusion as established, and by absorbing contest/series/prop series that this mechanism does not describe.

findings.text: Overtime stated as established without text: the contract section says series 'settle on the official final result of the named game, which includes overtime', the rules_evidence 'establishes' column says 'so overtime points are in the margin', and settlement_data_source says 'including overtime'. The only sampled text (KXNBAWINMARGIN) says 'official final result' in the postponement clause and nothing about overtime; KXNBAGAME/KXNBASPREAD are TITLE_ONLY. The ledger target string 'OT included per rules text' is the same unsupported inference. OT inclusion, push handling and strike construction must be moved to unresolved as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS (u1 only partly does).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Reworded settlement_definition, rules_evidence establishes, settlement_data_source and u1 so overtime inclusion, push handling and strike construction are an inference (the only sampled text says official final result in the postponement clause), not a verified fact.

findings.text: Series mis-mapping: of the 14 mapped series, KXNBAHIGHESTSCORING, KXNBASLAMDUNK, KXNBAH2H3PT (player head-to-head threes), KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT (team stat head-to-head), KXNBACUPGROUPWIN, KXNBAGAMEHIGHSCORE and KXNBAWINMARGIN are not moneyline/spread markets, and KXNBAHOMECLINCH, KXNBAGAME7, KXNBASERIESGCOMEBACK need a series-win model (home-court schedule, series length, game dependence) that appears only as a secondary partial input (nba.series_game_conditional_state). The record admits 'covered only superficially', but there is no unresolved entry and no required input for series win probability or Cup group tie-breaks, so those series have no usable input list in any record.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added 12 entries to contract.series_mapping_issues routing contest, series, Cup-group, Summer League and player/team-stat head-to-head tickers to their intended archetypes (or a NEW_ARCHETYPE_NEEDED), stated that this record serves only KXNBAGAME/KXNBASPREAD, and added u5 for the series-state and Cup members that lack inputs.

findings.text: KXNBALOTTERYODDS (lottery winner odds) is mapped here but its mechanism is the draft-lottery table in awards_draft; no stage or input addresses it.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Recorded KXNBALOTTERYODDS in series_mapping_issues as belonging to awards_draft; it is not claimed as covered here.

findings.text: Inputs left in despite WEAK verdicts: nba.onoff, nba.matchup_def, nba.score_resid remain in stage input_ids (s2, s3, s5); nba.travel_altitude is a DUPLICATE_OF nba.rest_travel yet still listed in s3 and the DATA row. Home-court value is stated as 'roughly two points' without source, and 'margin sd about 12' rests on recalled values (partly acknowledged).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed WEAK nba.onoff, nba.matchup_def, nba.score_resid and DUPLICATE nba.travel_altitude from stage, coverage and data feeds, corrected the ot_model audit text, and added u6 tagging home-court value, margin sd and OT rate as unsourced recalled values.

findings.text: Scope is silent on in-game trading: contract text and status fields show game markets trade live, but every input is pregame-only (pregame_knowable) and no record in this file states that in-play state (score, time, fouls, lineup on court) is out of scope.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added a scope variant stating that all inputs are pregame-knowable and that in-play state is out of scope for this record.

game_overtime_and_team_events.rederivation_notes: My chain: P(OT) = P(regulation margin = 0) = integer mass of the margin density at zero (~3.3% at a pick-em for sd 12 from a normal) inflated empirically to ~6% by tie-forcing and intentional-foul end-game structure, falling with |spread|; series OT adds series length x per-game OT. Bench points = bench minutes x bench pts/min with starter-flag definition risk; team-stat head-to-head needs a pair-difference distribution with tie rule. The rule text for KXNBAOT (found under first_basket) reads 'at least 1 overtime period is played ... resolves to a fair price' for >48-hour postponement. The record's chain matches mine and its Gaussian-mass-then-kappa treatment is sound; I recomputed phi(mu/sigma)/sigma: pick-em 3.3%, 10 pts 2.35%, 14 pts 1.7%. It differs by deriving a bench-points/team-stat model for contracts that do not appear live while the actually live OT series are filed elsewhere.

findings.text: Mis-keyed archetype: ledger shows 0 live series here, while KXNBAOT and KXNBASERIESOT (overtime, the only contracts this archetype's reg_tie_pmf_model applies to) sit under first_basket and KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT under game_moneyline_spread. As filed, no live contract is served by this record and the live OT contracts are served by first-basket inputs. Bench-points and team-stat head-to-head targets have no evidence they exist as live Kalshi markets; the author says so but still spends most of the record on them.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added contract.series_mapping_issues naming KXNBAOT and KXNBASERIESOT (filed under first_basket) and KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT (filed under game_moneyline_spread) as belonging here, stated that live-series claims are conditional on the re-key, and flagged that bench-points and team-stat targets have no live evidence (settlement text and u1 updated).

findings.text: Series-overtime (KXNBASERIESOT) has no real mechanism: nba.ot_period_distribution's measurement says 'for series OT use sum of independent' per-game indicators, which ignores series length (a random 4-7), the 2-2-1-1-1 structure and the fact that closeness correlates across games. The rule text for the series variant was never sampled, so even the definition ('at least one OT game in the series' vs count) is unverified; this belongs in unresolved as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS and as a required input (nba.series_model).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced the independent-Bernoulli series formula in nba.ot_period_distribution with a series-length mixture using nba.series_model (attached as new_input, added to stage s3) plus cross-game dependence, and added u6 for the unsampled KXNBASERIESOT definition.

findings.text: Numerical claims contradict the formula given: stage s1/mechanism text says P(OT) is 'below 1.5% at 14' points; phi(14/12)/12 = 1.7%. The ~30% decline 'at a 10-point spread' is consistent (2.35% vs 3.3%), but the claimed 'excess factor 1.7-1.9' is recalled, not estimated (u2). More importantly, the Gaussian regulation-tie mass treats the margin as continuous; an NBA margin pmf has parity structure tied to free-throw and three counts, so P(0) differs from the density value; this is the correction the record's own win_margin sibling cites but this record omits.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected the 14-point figure to about 1.7% (phi(14/12)/12), and changed nba.reg_tie_pmf_model to estimate the integer-valued margin pmf at zero (parity, free-throw and three-point structure) via kappa instead of the continuous density.

findings.text: P(second OT | first OT) 'about 0.07-0.10' and OT points 'mean about 22-26 total' are stated without source or SOURCE_UNVERIFIED tag; league history suggests the multi-OT share of OT games is higher than 10%. Bench-points figures (mean ~35, sd ~8, 90-100 bench minutes when close) are likewise unsourced.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u7

findings.text: nba.q_scoring is IRRELEVANT but stage s5 and the Team shot counts DATA row still list it; nba.off_rtg/def_rtg are WEAK yet remain talent_strength COVERED inputs.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed IRRELEVANT nba.q_scoring and WEAK off_rtg/def_rtg from stage and data lists; talent_strength coverage now rests on attached nba.lineup_adj_rating.

game_total.rederivation_notes: My chain: total = possessions x combined points per possession (+ OT block). Possessions from two tempos (not simple average; transition rate, turnovers, dead-ball time); ppp from opponent-adjusted offence and defence with the actual active set (who is out affects pace and efficiency differently); free-throw volume (fouls, crew); three-point variance dominant noise; late-game fouling in close games adds points; OT with P~6% adds ~24 points; series-length contracts are a different (count-of-games) process; Summer League differs. Rule text for KXNBATOTAL: 'If over 274.5 total points are scored in the ... game'; secondary text: 'resolve based on the official final result'; nothing explicit about overtime. The record matches my chain closely, correctly states that OT inclusion is not stated, and adds sensible composition and variance-load inputs. Differences: KXNBASERIESGAMES and KXNBASUMMERTOTAL are carried in the key but served by little, and a few numeric claims are unsourced.

findings.text: KXNBASERIESGAMES (series total games) is a count of games in a best-of-seven, not a points process; the record handles it only with nba.series_length_distribution (secondary) and the undefined id nba.series_model. No rules text exists, so the strike construction (over 5.5 games?) and the treatment of a series that ends early are unverified, and the 'game-to-game correlation about +0.05' parameter is unsourced. Series-length inputs also needed in other archetypes (win-margin of series, series OT) are not shared. It should be re-keyed to the series family or carry its own gap entry beyond u1.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Recorded KXNBASERIESGAMES (to series_and_cup) and KXNBASUMMERTOTAL (to summer_league_games) in series_mapping_issues, attached nba.series_model as a defined new_input feeding the series-length data, and added u6 (CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS strike construction, early-ending series, unsourced +0.05 correlation).

findings.text: The ledger target says 'OT included per rules text'; the text does not say so, and the record's own contract section correctly says it is 'not explicitly stated'. Other records (game_moneyline_spread, game_win_margin) assert OT inclusion as verified, so the key set is inconsistent.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Ledger target text is outside my editable files; this record already says overtime is not explicitly stated, and the sibling records game_moneyline_spread and game_win_margin now also treat overtime inclusion as an inference, making the key set consistent. Also corrected the quoted rule wording to match the sampled text.

findings.text: Crew effect 'about +/-3 points in total at the extremes', 'total sd of about 14' from shot noise, and 'cross term about 1.5-2' points are unsourced numerics; referee assignment availability is flagged SOURCE_UNVERIFIED (u4) but nba.referee_crew is KEEP_SECONDARY on a feed not verified to be machine-readable.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u7

findings.text: KXNBASUMMERTOTAL has no input (u5 admits none transfers); Summer League minutes plans (nba.summer_league_minutes exists in the catalog) are not attached.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Attached catalog input nba.summer_league_minutes (context) to stage s2 and its data feed, mapped KXNBASUMMERTOTAL to summer_league_games, and rewrote u5 to say the NBA rating inputs do not transfer.

findings.text: nba.fouls_ft overlaps nba.referee_crew and nba.late_game_script (audited KEEP_SECONDARY, not DUPLICATE); nba.standings_motivation and nba.score_resid stay in the key despite WEAK/KEEP_CONTEXT verdicts.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Clarified the nba.fouls_ft audit reason so its scope (team rate) is disjoint from referee_crew and late_game_script, removed WEAK nba.score_resid and DUPLICATE nba.travel_altitude from stage, coverage and feeds; nba.standings_motivation stays as a KEEP_CONTEXT input.

game_win_margin.rederivation_notes: My chain: band probability = CDF difference of the signed final margin over closed integer bands per side (e.g. 'wins ... by 6 to 10 points'), sums to one across all bands and both teams. Needs mean margin from active-set ratings, sd (pace-dependent), the zero hole (no ties, OT converts ties to small margins), end-of-game fouling effects on small margins, garbage-time decay after starters pull, and top-band tail. Rule text (filed under moneyline): 'wins the game by 6 to 10 points'; secondary 'resolve based on the official final result'. OT inclusion is not stated. The record's chain matches mine and adds good pull-timing and second-unit inputs. It differs by asserting OT inclusion, by using a market-ladder object as a stage input, and by being keyed to an archetype with no live series.

findings.text: Market-derived value used as an input: m.ladder_structure is audited BENCHMARK_ONLY ('derived from Kalshi prices ... carries no information about the underlying result') yet appears in stage s5 input_ids (band construction and coherence) and in settlement_contract COVERED. A coherence constraint is a structural property of the contract (bands sum to one) and should not be sourced from quoted prices.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed BENCHMARK_ONLY m.ladder_structure from stage s5 inputs and from the settlement_contract COVERED claim; coherence is now stated as enforced by construction from one own-model integer pmf (s5 text and category note updated).

findings.text: Overtime stated as verified: contract text says 'settled on the official final result including overtime' and settlement_data_source says 'overtime included'; the quoted rule text contains no overtime wording. All of stage s4 (OT conversion into low bands, nba.ot_final_margin_pmf) rests on this unstated inclusion and the author lists it under variants, not unresolved CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS.

findings.text: Mis-keyed: the live series KXNBAWINMARGIN is filed under game_moneyline_spread, so this record has no live series and rules_evidence is empty although the rule text is available in the evidence pack. Band set (1-5, 11-15, 16+) is taken from the ledger's example string and never observed; per-side construction and the open-ended top band are guesses and the open top band changes tail-input requirements.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Recorded KXNBAWINMARGIN in series_mapping_issues as belonging here (ledger files it under game_moneyline_spread), marked only the 6 to 10 band as observed with other bands and the open top band as unverified, and stated the tail-input consequence in the variants.

findings.text: Sensitivity claim 'a one-point change in sd moves the 6-10 band by about 2 percentage points' at mean 6: with a normal margin, sd 12 vs 13 gives ~16.3% vs ~15.0%, about 1.3 points. 'Spikes about 10-20% relative deviation at margins 1-8' is unmeasured (u2) but is also used as a nonlinearity statement.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Corrected the sd sensitivity in stage s1 to about 1.2 points on the 6-10 band (16.3% vs 15.0% for sd 12 vs 13) and 1.4 on P(win), and tagged the 10-20% parity spike as recalled (u2) in the nonlinearity text.

findings.text: nba.score_resid (WEAK), nba.def_scheme (WEAK) and nba.def_rtg (redundant with lineup_adj_rating) remain in stage input lists; efficiency_conversion is NOT_APPLICABLE even though three-point luck drives margin variance and the record's own sibling treats it as input.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Dropped WEAK score_resid and def_scheme and redundant def_rtg (now DUPLICATE_OF lineup_adj_rating) from stage/coverage/feeds; added own-model nba.margin_heteroscedasticity and attached nba.three_pt_luck, making efficiency_conversion COVERED.

off_court_events.rederivation_notes: My chain: stage-gated process against a deadline: feasibility under league rules/finances (cap, apron, approvals) -> actor incentive hazard -> deal stage progression (exploration, exclusivity, definitive agreement, league approval, closing) -> information flow and reporter reliability -> wording/qualifying-act mapping and time-zone window edge. The rules text samples show narrow stages: KXNBATEAMSALE 'The deal must be finalized and approved by the Governing League', KXNBASTAKESALE 'Negotiations, letters of intent, drafts, rumors, and unexecuted or conditional announcements do not count', KXNBAEUROPEANNOUNCE needs a 'confirmed inaugural season'. Required inputs: qualifying-stage requirement, deal-stage ledger/pipeline, reporter reliability by stage, base rates/calendar hazard, rule-feasibility data, actor incentive signals. The record matches this well and its quotes are verbatim. It differs by labelling the rules status as fully verified and by leaving many mapped series unrouted.

findings.text: rules_verification is VERIFIED_FROM_RULES_TEXT although the record's own variants and u1 state that 15 of 22 live series (trade, pick trade, relocation, stadium, next contract, apology, executive award, player/game specials, White House attend, city expand, franchise owner, join conference, join CBA, team announce) have no sampled rules. The correct value is PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; the over-claim hides that most series settlement is unseen. Also 'Windows are in Eastern Time and end on stated dates; absent the event, all markets resolve No' generalises from one or two samples (KXNBAEUROPEANNOUNCE, KXNBAFRANCHISECOST, KXNBANEXTGOVERNOR).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Changed rules_verification to PARTIALLY_VERIFIED (7 of 22 series have sampled rules) and restricted the Eastern Time and resolve-No wording in settlement_definition to the series whose sampled text states it.

findings.text: Series mis-mapping inside the key: KXNBAEXEC (Executive of the Year) is an award vote, KXNBAPLAYERSPECIALS and KXNBAGAMESPECIALS are probably on-court count specials (the NBA_b file has an unreg 'team_and_player_counting_specials' archetype), KXNBANEXTCONTRACT is a scalar contract-size market and KXNBANEXTTEAM/KXNBANEXTTEAMCONF are also served by player_availability s3. None of these processes is a stage-gated organisational event, and the record's stages do not describe them; the author never marks them as unrouted.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added six series_mapping_issues (Executive of the Year to awards_draft, player and game specials to the counting-specials archetype, Next Contract/Next Team/Next Team Conference to a needed player_transaction_destination archetype), rewrote the multi-outcome variant, attached the shared nba.player_move_destination_model, and made the player_availability mapping consistent.

findings.text: KXNBARULE (one free throw rule adoption) and KXNBAFRANCHISECOST (headline value above strike, bundled assets stripped) need inputs not defined here: board-of-governors/competition-committee vote calendar and rule-change history for the former, and a valuation reference class (comparable franchise sale and expansion fee prices, not just base rates) for the latter. nba.offfield_base_rate pooled across event types is acknowledged as heterogeneous (u5) but no per-type input is added.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added nba.rule_change_pipeline (committee and Board of Governors vote calendar, proposal-stage history) and nba.franchise_valuation_comps (comparable-sale regression for the strike) with exact measurements, stage s3 inputs, coverage and a new dataset; updated u4/u5 to state that pooled base rates remain for other families.

findings.text: Irrelevant/weak inputs left in stages and data feeds: nba.draft_board (IRRELEVANT) and nba.all_star_process (KEEP_CONTEXT, no live series) still feed the 'Player career status' DATA row; nba.standings_motivation and nba.injury_risk_season are WEAK yet listed under situational/availability coverage.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed IRRELEVANT nba.draft_board and no-live-series nba.all_star_process from the career-status data feed, and removed WEAK nba.injury_risk_season and nba.standings_motivation from the coverage lists and feeds (standings_motivation stays only in stage s2 and interaction 2 for coach-firing markets, which have no live series).

findings.text: Several numeric hazard claims (report completion about 0.1 for 'talks' to 0.95+ for 'agreed' tier-one, retirement hazard 20-25% per year at age 38+, supermajority approval threshold) are recalled and only the last is tagged SOURCE_UNVERIFIED (u3).
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u6

parlay_combo.rederivation_notes: My chain: joint probability of leg vector; dependence via shared latent factors (game total/pace, margin/blowout minutes, team shooting luck, availability shock) and within-team allocation; legs have their own marginals; void-leg treatment inside a combo unknown (single-leg player contracts void at fair price). Nested/implied legs (spread leg implies moneyline leg; PRA contains its components) create perfect dependence. Needs own-model marginals on a shared information set, a factor/copula or game simulation, and the combo contract rule for voids/pushes. The record's chain matches mine (game-level simulation, void-state input, factor loadings) and correctly marks NO_LIVE_SERIES. It differs by using a market-derived total as a factor, an unsupported sign flip for underdog stars, and by omitting implied-leg structure.

findings.text: Market-derived value smuggled in as an input: nba.implied_team_totals is audited BENCHMARK_ONLY ('derived from sportsbook spread and total, which are market prices; use an own-model team total') but is listed in stage s2 input_ids, in pace_volume COVERED, in an interaction with nba.score_resid, and as the feed of the 'Sportsbook same-game parlay prices (benchmark only)' DATA row (SGP prices cannot yield a team total). The audit and the mechanism contradict each other.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed BENCHMARK_ONLY nba.implied_team_totals from stage s2, pace_volume coverage and the margin-total interaction, added the market-free nba.own_model_team_totals with an exact measurement, and re-pointed the sportsbook same-game-parlay dataset to feed m.external_lines only.

findings.text: Unsupported dependence claim: s3 says the favourite-cover/star-over pair is 'negatively associated for the favourite's stars and positively associated for the underdog's stars. ... sign flips with team side'. In lopsided games starters of both teams lose minutes (the trailing coach also pulls starters), so the minutes link is through |margin|, symmetric across sides, while only the usage/score-state effect is side-specific. A side-signed spread feature would mis-specify the required input (the record's own nonlinearity says 'hinge in spread ... sign flips with side'). No SOURCE_UNVERIFIED tag is attached.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Rewrote stage s3, its distribution, the garbage nonlinearity and interaction 0 so the minutes link is a function of |expected margin| and negative for both teams' stars, with only the usage and score-state effect side-specific; sizes tagged recalled in u6.

findings.text: Missing structure: nested and logically implied legs (spread cover implies moneyline win; N+ implies lower N+; PRA with its component legs) produce degenerate or perfect dependence that a Gaussian-copula factor model cannot represent; the record neither lists this as a settlement hazard nor as an unresolved item, and leg-count/composition limits are unknown (u1 only mentions cross-game and fixed thresholds).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added a nested/implied-leg variant, a stage s5 statement that legs are evaluated on shared simulated game draws so implication holds exactly, and u5 CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS on leg-count limits and nested legs.

findings.text: Evidence base is empty (no live series, no rules text); every dependence figure (-0.1 to -0.3 within-team, margin/total correlation 0.0-0.1, spread knee about 6) is recalled and only u2/u3 admit uncertainty. The 'Monte Carlo SE 0.5-1 pp at 10,000 draws' is correct for p~0.5 but not for the small joint probabilities typical of parlays.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u6

findings.text: nba.minutes is audited KEEP_SECONDARY but the audit says the relevant object is 'minutes as a function of game state, not a projection'; the stage lists the projection input unchanged. nba.combo_covariance is acknowledged as within-player only, so it should not appear in cross-player stages s3/s4.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced the single nba.minutes projection with nba.minutes_scenario_mixture (same definition as combo_props) in stages, coverage, interactions and feeds, re-audited nba.minutes as a duplicate, and moved within-player nba.combo_covariance out of cross-player stages s3/s4 into s5; also corrected the Monte Carlo SE claim for small joint probabilities.

player_assists.rederivation_notes: My chain: assists = team made FGs while on court x share of those he assisted. Minutes (blowout truncation, foul trouble, early exit) -> time of possession/potential assists -> co-creator load and teammate absence (finisher vs creator) -> team assisted-FG pool (pace, FG%, assisted rate, opponent scheme) -> teammate shooting luck (largest noise) -> official-scorer credit and later corrections -> overdispersed count crossing an integer line. Rule text: KXNBAAST 'If a player is inactive, or active but never takes the court, the market settles to a fair price. Once a player enters the game the market settles based on the player's assists recorded.'; KXNBAASTPROT adds the first-half-only void at the pre-tip fair price unless the strike is already reached. Required inputs: injuries, minutes mixture, early-exit hazard for the protected variant, potential assists, assist share, teammate conversion, opponent assists allowed, pace/own-model environment, scorer bias. The record matches nearly all of this. It differs by omitting the early-exit hazard for the live protected series and by using a market-derived team total.

findings.text: KXNBAASTPROT is a live series whose defining mechanic is the first-half-only void, but the record has no input for it: u3 says 'the early-exit hazard for guards is not modelled in this archetype' while combo_props defines nba.early_exit_hazard for the same clause. A required input for a live series is therefore missing; the stage s1 text and 'regime' inputs cover only zero-minute voids.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added nba.early_exit_hazard (identical definition to combo_props) as a new_input for the protected series, wired it into stage s1, availability coverage and the play-by-play feed, and updated u3 to say the first-half-only void is now modelled.

findings.text: Market-derived value used as an input: nba.implied_team_totals is audited BENCHMARK_ONLY ('replace with an own-model assisted-FGM environment') yet is an input of stage s3, the pace_volume COVERED entry and the box-score DATA row feeds list. The replacement (nba.team_assisted_fgm_expectation) exists, so the benchmark should be removed from stage and coverage lists.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed BENCHMARK_ONLY nba.implied_team_totals from stage s3, the pace_volume COVERED list and the box-score feeds; pace_volume now rests on nba.pace, nba.touches and the own-model nba.team_assisted_fgm_expectation.

findings.text: SOURCE_UNVERIFIED (partly disclosed in u1): the DATA row 'Tracking passing and possession data' lists fields keyed by game_id from nba_api leaguedashptstats; that endpoint is a season/per-game aggregate and game-level rows are only obtainable by single-date filtering (a workaround, not a documented game grain). nba.pot_ast is KEEP_PRIMARY on this basis and the 'cross-game sd about 25% of the mean' claim cannot be measured from free data.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u1

findings.text: nba.usage is WEAK yet remains in s2 input_ids; nba.tracking is DUPLICATE_OF nba.pot_ast but is still referenced in s2 and in the DATA feeds. Claim 'a lead guard might average 12 potential assists per 36 minutes' understates league-leading creators (high teens per game) and is unsourced.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed WEAK nba.usage and DUPLICATE nba.tracking from stage s2 and data feeds, and replaced the unsourced 12-potential-assists-per-36 claim with a hedged per-game range tagged recalled/unsourced.

findings.text: The overtime sentence ('whether overtime assists count for the total is not stated but follows official box-score totals') is an inference correctly flagged only in variants; it should also be in unresolved as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS. rules_verification is VERIFIED_FROM_RULES_TEXT although KXNBAASTPROT's inactive/OT clauses are truncated in the evidence pack.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Changed rules_verification to PARTIALLY_VERIFIED, rewrote the overtime variant to say overtime inclusion is unstated, and added u5 CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS covering overtime and the truncated KXNBAASTPROT secondary text.

player_availability.rederivation_notes: My chain: the key's live contracts are not game-level 'is he active' markets. KXNBASTARTERS: first game of the season, coach lineup choice constrained by health; the text requires 'on the floor at the time of the opening tip-off'. KXNBANEXTTEAM: transaction process with a catch-all (Retires / No Team) and re-sign handling. KXNBAONE3PT: Poisson-like accrual of a rare make over regular-season games with an explicit exposure window. KXNBARETURN: recovery time-to-event. KXNBAPLAYTOGETHER/COMPETE: joint presence. Required inputs: injury timelines, preseason starter signals, contract/cap feasibility, attempts-per-game and make rate with exposure, rest policy, destination model. The record matches this and its quotes are verbatim; it explicitly notes that the archetype label (game-level starter/active status) has no live series. It differs mainly by an audit/usage inconsistency on rest_travel and unsourced base rates.

findings.text: Inconsistent audit: nba.rest_travel is audited IRRELEVANT ('single-game availability driver') yet is an input of stages s4 and s5, the situational_schedule_motivation coverage, and the Three-point attempts DATA row feeds list. Either rest/load policy is a required input for season exposure (the interaction rare_make_accrual_rate x load_mgmt says so) or it is not; the input list cannot be relied on as written.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed IRRELEVANT nba.rest_travel from stages s4/s5, the situational_schedule_motivation coverage and the three-point data feed; the coverage note now says season-level rest enters through nba.load_mgmt and the audit stays IRRELEVANT, so the audit and the mechanism agree.

findings.text: Series mis-mapping: KXNBANEXTTEAM and KXNBANEXTTEAMCONF are transaction-process markets that the off_court_events record also claims in its variants ('Next Team and Next Contract markets') but neither record defines their destination inputs consistently (here: nba.player_move_destination_model; there: nba.transaction_flow/pipeline). KXNBAONE3PT is a season-accrual stat market. The key mixes four processes and the record models each only lightly; for KXNBARETURN/PLAYTOGETHER/COMPETE no rules text exists and the 'return' definition is CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS (disclosed).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added series_mapping_issues for KXNBANEXTTEAM and KXNBANEXTTEAMCONF (to off_court_events, with the shared destination input) and KXNBAONE3PT (to season_stat_markets), and restated in settlement_definition which series this key owns and that coverage of the others is conditional.

findings.text: Numeric priors stated as facts in stage text (starters retain role about 80% SOURCE_UNVERIFIED; 20-30% of returns slip; status-to-play rates Out 0.05, Doubtful 0.15-0.25, Questionable 0.5, Probable 0.9+). An 'Out' status plays far less than 5%; only some are tagged in u3.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Changed the status-to-play step to Out near zero and Doubtful 0.05-0.25 with a recalled-values tag, and widened u3 to list every recalled prior (starter retention, return slippage, status-to-play rates).

findings.text: KXNBASTARTERS rules text is for the opening game only and the ticker is already finalized; the record's nba.opening_night_starter_signals is correctly scoped, but nba.starters_pit (30-minute confirmation) is KEEP_PRIMARY for a market that settles on a state the record says is known only at the tip; confirmation vintage matters only for mid-season analogues that have no live series.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Re-audited nba.starters_pit as KEEP_SECONDARY with a reason stating that the live KXNBASTARTERS series is finalized and settles on the tip-time state, so confirmation vintage matters mainly for in-season analogues without a live series.

findings.text: The 'one three' exposure window says Cup games before the final count and the Cup final does not; the interaction with a mid-season Cup schedule (number of regular-season games with minutes) is not expressed as an input, and the Gamma shape k=3 is a placeholder (u5).
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u6

player_escalator_payout.rederivation_notes: My chain: scalar payout g(K) of a single-game count K (points in 2-point bands, made threes 0 to 10+); value = E[g(K)] so the convexity of g puts weight on the tail. Needs availability and early-exit/void rule, minutes mixture with heavy-minutes tail (close games, OT), attempt volume (3PA/FGA/FTA), make-rate clustering (beta-binomial), composite points parity from 2-pt bands vs FT/3 counts, and the payout table, cap and non-appearance rule from the contract. There is no live series and no rules text, and the ledger family is 'NBA/UNMAPPED_SERIES', so I cannot confirm any such Kalshi contract exists. The record matches my chain and checks out arithmetically (beta-binomial rho 0.03 with 10 attempts gives variance factor 1+9x0.03=1.27, consistent with its 15-30% claim). It differs by presenting its mechanism and primary/secondary labels as if a contract were known.

findings.text: Existence of the contract type is unverified: no series, no rules text and no ticker; the family is 'NBA/UNMAPPED_SERIES' and the catalog target ('points in 2-point bands, 0-10+ threes') is an example, not evidence. The record flags NO_LIVE_SERIES but still rates inputs primary/secondary (nba.heavy_minutes_tail_prob, nba.three_volume) and writes a payout-operator nonlinearity; the primary roles should be conditional on a contract appearing. u1 should be DATA_UNAVAILABLE as well as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: reviewer claim incorrect because the evidence pack lists KXNBAESCALATORPTS (RULES_TEXT, under player_points) and KXNBAESCALATOR3PT (under player_threes) with scalar formulas such as "Payout Formula = floor(10000 x (y / 50)^3) / 10000"; the series are misfiled, so I recorded series_mapping_issues and rewrote the contract text, operator and nonlinearity with the real cubic schedules.

findings.text: Availability coverage is thin: category availability_news is covered only by nba.injuries_pit, with no early-exit hazard and no teammate-absence shift although the record's own settlement variants (protected/unprotected, non-appearance paying the lowest band vs fair price) depend on the void state. The two void treatments imply different effective distributions (mass at zero vs conditional on playing) and need a P(void) input.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added nba.early_exit_hazard (same definition as combo_props) and attached nba.teammate_absence_shift as new_inputs wired into stages s2/s3 and the injury dataset, and listed non-appearance as CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS in u1 with the two void treatments stated.

findings.text: Several numerics are unsourced or only partly tagged: beta-binomial rho 0.02-0.05 (SOURCE_UNVERIFIED only in s4), 'heavy-minute component of 10-20% for stars', attempt sd 30-40% of mean, minutes-attempts correlation 0.6-0.7, 'weight about 0.3 at 100 attempts'.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u5

findings.text: nba.ratings is WEAK but stage s5 lists it; nba.ft_attempts is irrelevant for the threes variant and the points variant needs FGA per minute, which the audit asks for but no defined input supplies (usage proxy only).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed WEAK nba.ratings from stage s5, coverage and feeds, and added nba.fga_per_minute_by_shot_type with an exact measurement as the missing FGA-per-minute input for the points variant (nba.ft_attempts stays only for points, noted as irrelevant for threes).

player_free_throws.rederivation_notes: My chain: FTM = FTA x make probability. FTA from trips (shooting fouls on drives/post-ups, bonus-state non-shooting fouls, technicals, intentional fouls late in close games) x 1-3 attempts per trip; attempts clustered and overdispersed; make probability a stable skill with binomial noise given attempts; minutes (blowouts cut late free throws), opponent foul rate, crew whistle, late-game fouling and hack-a policies; availability and teammate absence drive volume; N+ needs at least N attempts so there is zero mass for non-shooters. No live series and no rules text; settlement (technicals, OT, void for inactive) is therefore inference. The record matches my chain and adds trip-structure, bonus-state and skill-posterior inputs. It differs by leaving availability as a GAP, by an arithmetic slip on late-game share, and by omitting mid-game intentional fouling.

findings.text: Availability is a declared GAP (u2: 'The archetype has no injury-status input at all'), yet own availability and a teammate's absence (shifting drives and rim attempts) are the first gate of the count and nba.injuries_pit exists in the catalog and is attached in every sibling record. The input list cannot be relied on for the void/DNP branch or usage redistribution until it is added.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Attached nba.injuries_pit and nba.teammate_absence_shift as defined new_inputs (stage s1, a new injury-snapshot dataset and feeds), switched availability_news from GAP to COVERED, and rewrote u2 to the remaining untested question.

findings.text: No contract evidence: no live series and no rules text, so the strike construction, protected/unprotected void rule and overtime/technical counting are pure analogy (contract section says so). The ledger has the key as blueprint 'combo' with no tickers. Existence of an NBA free-throws-made series on Kalshi is unverified and should be recorded as DATA_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u5

findings.text: Arithmetic slip in nonlinearity: 'The last five minutes of close games carry about 25-30% of a star's free throws in about 5 percent of the minutes'; five minutes is about 10% of the 48-minute game and about 14% of a star's 35 minutes. The 25-30% figure is also unsourced.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Replaced the wrong 5-percent-of-minutes figure with about 10% of game minutes (12-15% of a star's minutes) and labelled the 20-25% free-throw share as recalled and unsourced.

findings.text: Intentional-foul mechanism is limited to the last two minutes (nba.intentional_foul_target_prob); mid-game hack-a-player fouling away from the ball in Q1-Q3 is outside the last-two-minutes rule and is omitted. 'Pace' is audited WEAK but remains in s5 and DATA feeds.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Extended nba.intentional_foul_target_prob and stage s3 with a Q1-Q3 away-from-the-ball hack-a component, and removed WEAK nba.pace from stage s5, coverage and data feeds.

findings.text: nba.fouls_ft is DUPLICATE_OF nba.ft_attempts, but the stage s2 input list and DATA row for referee statistics still treat the foul-rate component as separate; the claim that 200 attempts pin FT% to about 3 points is correct for p~0.8 (se ~2.8) but the 80-attempt prior is a placeholder (u4).
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Removed DUPLICATE nba.fouls_ft from stage s2, coverage and the play-by-play/referee feeds so the foul-rate component is carried only by nba.ft_attempts, nba.ft_trip_structure_model and nba.referee_crew; the 200-attempt precision claim was already correct.

player_h2h_series_stats.rederivation_notes: My chain: head-to-head = distribution of X_A - X_B for two named players: each count from minutes x per-minute rate (opponent/assignment adjusted), counts correlated (opposing players positive via pace/script, teammates negative at fixed team output), integer ties with a tie rule that changes the price; series totals = sum over random games (series length 4-7, injuries, playoff minutes inflation); Summer League = unstable minutes plans and game selection. Settlement hazards: tie, one player DNP, OT, series average denominator. The live H2H series KXNBAH2H3PT (threes) is filed under game_moneyline_spread, KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT under moneyline too, KXNBASUMMERMVP under awards. The record matches my chain and models the pair correlation well. It differs by not owning any of the live H2H series and by a GAP on shooting regression for exactly the stat the only live H2H market uses.

findings.text: The only live head-to-head market (KXNBAH2H3PT, 'Head-to-Head Three Pointers') is a made-threes comparison, yet efficiency_conversion is a declared GAP: no shooting-luck regression (nba.player_shooting_regression exists) for threes made, where 3P% variance dominates and tie mass is largest. The record's key stat for the live contract has no conversion input, so the list cannot be relied on for its only evidenced use.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Attached nba.player_shooting_regression as a defined new_input (stage s3, data feed), switched efficiency_conversion from GAP to COVERED and rewrote u4 to the remaining question of series-length shrinkage.

findings.text: Series mis-mapping: KXNBAH2H3PT and KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT are not in this key's ledger (filed under game_moneyline_spread), so rules_evidence is empty and the contract section says they 'were not sampled' although KXNBAH2H3PT exists in the evidence pack as TITLE_ONLY. The team stat variant belongs with game_overtime_and_team_events. KXNBASUMMERMVP sits in awards_draft. As filed the record serves hypothetical series only.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: Added series_mapping_issues for KXNBAH2H3PT (belongs here, title only) and KXNBAH2HTEAM3PT (to game_overtime_and_team_events), corrected the claim that KXNBAH2H3PT was absent from the pack, and stated that series and Summer League stages are hypothetical; KXNBASUMMERMVP is handled in the awards_draft record.

findings.text: Unverified source claims: nba.playoff_matchup_assignment_shift is built on 'NBA.com matchups (nba_api leagueseasonmatchups)' with a game_id field; that endpoint is a season-type aggregate and playoff game-level assignments are not shown to be available (u2 admits this). The 5-15% matchup shift is SOURCE_UNVERIFIED only in a parenthesis; the input is rated secondary on an unchecked source.
findings.resolution: DEFERRED_TO_UNRESOLVED:u2

findings.text: Tie probability is stated inconsistently (10-20% in variants, 8-20% in nonlinearities, 'about 8-20%'), is not sourced for threes, and the tie rule is the main price driver but is not given a default scenario set.
